tool.name: coreone__member__read_primary_savings_balance
tool.description: Read a member's primary savings balance. Signs on to the CoreOne teller console, looks up a member by member number, opens the member record, and returns the current balance of the member's Primary Share (savings) account. Returns outputs ['savings_balance'] on success; business outcomes: MEMBER_NOT_FOUND, ACCESS_RESTRICTED, VALIDATION_ERROR. Max effect: write.
